issues.description: The problem statement requires the Farm to aggregate animals using a List and explicitly instructs initializing an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor, but the solution implements the animals collection as a Queue backed by a LinkedList (and exposes getter/setter using Queue). This is an attribute/type mismatch: students following the specification would implement List<Animal>/ArrayList<Animal>, while the reference uses Queue<Animal>/LinkedList<Animal>, causing confusion and potential test/assessment mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent with the problem statement. Change the solution (and any provided reference code) to use List<Animal> animals and initialize it as new ArrayList<>() in the no-argument constructor, and adjust getters/setters and addAnimal/feedAllAnimals/singFarmSong to operate on List. Alternatively, if Queue/LinkedList is preferred, update the problem statement and UML to specify Queue/LinkedList instead of List/ArrayList.
